notes: Light and heavy woods are not Quick-Start terrain. The book has one kind of woods, so the palette has one Woods piece.

Open question: the Movement Cost Table on p. 15 prints +2″ per 1″ of elevation, but the Level Change paragraph on the same page says +1″ per inch. The app quotes the table until the owner decides (D27).
Buildings block sight and slow movement. The app doesn’t track their damage yet.
The terrain on a printed mapsheet is the map’s own. Add pieces only for extra terrain.

items.title: Single tree
items.movement: Costs +1″ to move through. A ’Mech can’t end its move in it.
items.lineOfSight: Doesn’t block. Counts as 2″ of woods.
items.attack: Woods, +1, when the tree is between and more than 2″ from the attacker, or when the target touches it.

items.title: Woods
items.movement: Costs +1″ per inch moved through. A ’Mech can end its move in it.
items.lineOfSight: Blocked by 6″ or more of woods.
items.attack: Woods give the target +1 to the attack roll (once, even if the woods are both between and around the target). No partial cover.

items.title: Woods strip
items.movement: Costs +1″ per inch moved through. A ’Mech can end its move in it.
items.lineOfSight: Blocked by 6″ or more of woods.
items.attack: Woods give the target +1 to the attack roll (once, even if the woods are both between and around the target). No partial cover.

items.title: Hill
items.movement: No extra cost across the top. Each level change costs extra per inch up or down. At most 2″ of level change per 2″ moved; 3″ or more is prohibited.
items.lineOfSight: Blocks the shot if more than two-thirds of the target is behind it.
items.attack: Partial cover, +1, when one-third to two-thirds of the target is hidden.
items.choices: 1 choice (larger = 2). A smaller hill on top adds a level

items.title: Hill ridge
items.movement: No extra cost across the top. Each level change costs extra per inch up or down. At most 2″ of level change per 2″ moved; 3″ or more is prohibited.
items.lineOfSight: Blocks the shot if more than two-thirds of the target is behind it.
items.attack: Partial cover, +1, when one-third to two-thirds of the target is hidden.
items.choices: 1 choice (larger = 2). A smaller hill on top adds a level

items.title: Water
items.movement: Costs +1″ per inch, plus a level change going in and out.
items.attack: ’Mechs standing in it have partial cover, +1. Depth is 1″.

items.title: River
items.movement: Costs +1″ per inch, plus a level change going in and out.
items.attack: ’Mechs standing in it have partial cover, +1. Depth is 1″.

items.title: Rubble
items.movement: Same as rough: +1″ per inch moved through.

items.title: Small building
items.movement: Costs +1″ to +4″ by class. A ’Mech can’t end its move inside. It can climb on with a level change of 2″ or less, or jump on if its jump is at least the building’s height.
items.note: The app has no building damage until Clash of Steel rules arrive in Play. Buildings block sight and slow movement; the app doesn’t track their damage yet.

items.movement: Costs +1″ to +4″ by class. A ’Mech can’t end its move inside. It can climb on with a level change of 2″ or less, or jump on if its jump is at least the building’s height.
